text:
mariela_pm: Heads up team — Centaur Health (LATAM pilot) is scaling faster than forecasted. They're requesting a short-term regional routing + header-based allowlist to route traffic to our sa-east-1 edge, plus a temporary QPS bump for demos. This account is flagged as a renewal watch; want to be proactive. Can we approve a 72h exemption and schedule an audit? :thinking:

sarah.cs: Can you paste traffic numbers and the exact header they need? Also which IPs will be used?

mariela_pm: Current steady-state ~10 req/s (p95 ~220ms), demo spikes to ~90 req/s. Estimate ~45k tokens/day over the next 3 days. Header: X-Centaur-Env: demo-1. IPs below.

mariela_pm: IPs:
- 34.120.18.91
- 34.120.18.92
- 2801:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334

mariela_pm: Header example: ```
X-Centaur-Env: demo-1
```

tony.ops: We can create a temporary "header pin" routing rule + a rate window. Need an infra config snippet to hand to eng-infra and an owner for rollback/monitoring.

net-eng: @tony.ops I'll add the header matcher and CIDR entries and sticky route to sa-east-1 pool. Confirm duration and autorevoke behavior?

mariela_pm: 72h from now. Please set a 24h pre-warning and auto-revoke after 72h unless CS approves extension. Also set an alert if utilization exceeds 60% for >30m.

tony.ops: Draft policy we can apply: ```json
{"route":"sa-east-1","match":"header:X-Centaur-Env=demo-1","source_ips":["34.120.18.91/32","34.120.18.92/32","2801:0db8:85a3::7334/128"],"qps":100,"duration":"72h","prewarn":"24h","util_alert_pct":60}```

sarah.cs: Looks good. Add a short customer note and mark in the renewal tracker that we did a temporary exemption. Also schedule a 48h check-in to verify latency and token usage.

mariela_pm: I'll add the note and take the 48h eval with them. Please make sure the change is audited and costs are tracked.

net-eng: Applied staging rule, beginning prod rollout in ~10m. tagging @deploy-bot for rollout and suppression window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting rollout (change-id: roll-177888). 1/3 hosts updated. Alert suppression enabled for 30m to avoid noise.

tony.ops: Prod rule applied. Matched header + IPs now route to sa-east-1 with 100 QPS. Auto-revoke scheduled for 72h; 24h pre-warning. Owner: mariela_pm.

sarah.cs: Thanks — I'll add entry to renewal playbook and set calendar reminder for the 48h review. Please ping if anything abnormal. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout complete (change-id: roll-177888). No errors.

net-eng: Change logged in infra-audit with link to this thread. We'll export token-cost delta and latency histogram after 48h.

mariela_pm: I'll run the 48h eval with Centaur and post findings here. Closing the loop once done. Thanks all! :rocket:
